messages:
Maya C: Quick capture from VentureCore onboarding (4/21 call) — raw notes for triage. Pls escalate any renewal-impact items.

Liam R: thanks — can you paste the asks and any quotes?

Maya C: Collated notes below — grouped by type.
- Search relevance/regression: after last patch their rerank score ordering got worse on some queries; they said "latest results push older docs above the new ones for some queries". Impact: failed demo with execs.
- Index freshness: bulk index job shows docs marked as "indexed" but they are not returned for ~6hrs. They said: "We awaited new docs for a morning and they never showed up in our dashboard queries".
- Billing/quotas: they hit a large-embed spike and want a per-team quota + alerting (not just account-level). Asking for a soft cap + email alert before overage.
- Import failures at scale: during a 50k import they saw sporadic 502/timeout errors and ~2% of docs never retried.

Aisha P: Noted. Routing suggestion: relevance/regression -> product-ml + evals; freshness -> infra/serving; quotas -> billing & account team; import errors -> eng-runtime.

Priya: Agree with routing. Priority: label index freshness and relevance as P1 for this account (risking renewal). Quotas are P2 (affects onboarding).

Tom: Can we capture repro artifacts for freshness? timestamps of upload + sample query + request ids. Also want the failing query examples for rerank.

Maya C: Upload details I have from VentureCore:
- Job CSV: vc_import_2026-04-21_09.csv
- They reported an upload at 09:03:14 and queries at 09:15 returned nothing; next successful sighting at ~15:40.
- Customer quote: "We couldn't demo product updates because search shuffled in old docs — super embarrassing".

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-5102: VentureCore index freshness + missing docs (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5102)
product-bot: Created ticket CS-5103: VentureCore search relevance regression (https://redwood.atlassian/CS-5103)

Liam R: I'll own gathering support logs and sample queries. Can someone from infra grab ingest pipeline metrics and cache invalidation traces?

Aisha P: I'll loop in infra; assigning to infra-oncall and eng-runtime. Also capturing quota ask: suggested implementation — per-team soft cap + webhook/email alert + opt-in auto-throttle.

Tom: For the import failures I'll add a small snippet to reproduce with parallel uploads and note the error responses. Quick log paste from VentureCore:
```
2026-04-21T09:03:14Z start upload job=vc_50k batch=1 user=vc_admin
2026-04-21T09:03:18Z ingest ready shards=16 job=vc_50k
2026-04-21T09:03:19Z write->index queue=write-buffer delayed
2026-04-21T09:03:21Z 502 upstream read_timeout id=xyz987
2026-04-21T09:03:21Z retry schedule id=xyz987 attempts=1
2026-04-21T15:40:02Z query get_results qid=abc123 returned=5
```

Priya: For prioritization at product sync on Friday: suggested scoring matrix for VentureCore issues: renewal_risk=3, demo_breakage=2, engineering_effort=2, customer_effort=1. We'll present CS-5102/CS-5103 with these weights.

Maya C: Customer language to capture: "If we can't fix freshness in time for our internal rollout we'll pause the pilot and review other vendors." Marking account: onboarding_at_risk, renewal_watch.

Liam R: I'll upload the sample CSV and query logs to CS-5102 and add curl examples. Also requesting a small eval in Redwood Optimize to compare pre/post patch ranking.

Aisha P: Adding UX note — onboarding docs UI should show clearer "indexing status" per batch (processing/in-progress/done) and a CTA to reindex. Routing that to ux-ops.

Maya C: Action items:
- Liam -> attach logs & CSV to CS-5102 (by EOD)
- Aisha -> ping infra + assign tracing (by tomorrow morning)
- Priya -> include weighted prioritization on Friday product sync
- Tom -> repro for import 502s in staging

Tom: I'll start a staging run and post results.

Maya C: Thanks team — I'll update VentureCore playbook and send them a short note acknowledging tickets and ETA. :pray:
